title: Add Logray icons.
description:
Add lricon.svg, which provides the core graphic element for the various
Logray icons. Add lricon*.png were created using the templates at
https://developer.apple.com/design/resources/. Add Logray.icns and
logray.ico, and use them in various packaging resources.

commits_data.title: Add Logray icons.
commits_data.message:
Add Logray icons.

Add lricon.svg and lriconinst.svg, which provide the core graphic
element for the various Logray icons. Add lricon*.png, which were
created using the templates at
https://developer.apple.com/design/resources/. Add Logray.icns,
logray.ico, and lograyinst.ico, and use them in various packaging
resources.
